project.name: InsiteApp Web Desktop Control Shell

intentProfile.routingReason: Existing desktop admin mock project expanded with a distinct KPI-driven dashboard page.

project.styleDefinitionBrief: Operational desktop admin shell with KPI-first portfolio dashboard and separate organization governance page.
project.designRead: dashboard admin / construction operations leadership / practical and trustworthy / dense / avoid activity-feed noise

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: deep teal shell (#08576E / #0D6E87), pale blue workspace (#E7F4F8), white cards, dark ink text, muted blue-gray copy, restrained semantic pills (info/success/warning/danger)
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: large radii, rounded-2xl / rounded-3xl feel, soft panel edges, compact pill controls
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: practical admin dashboard typography, strong titles, compact support copy, uppercase micro labels where useful
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: clean desktop spacing, medium-dense information layout, not airy marketing layout
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: persistent sidebar, top context bar, KPI cards, admin tables/panels, subtle borders, scan-friendly rows
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: darkest sidebar, lighter top context bar, pale workspace canvas, white elevated cards with soft shadows
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: minimal; prioritize data and administrative controls over decorative visuals
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: operational, trustworthy, visible controls, no hidden-overflow-first interaction model

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: deep teal left sidebar, pale workspace canvas, lighter top context bar, white content cards; active nav item uses filled teal-tint state
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: deep teal structural shell with restrained semantic status colors
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Inter/SF Pro admin dashboard scale with strong page title and compact supporting copy
sharedProjectShellContract.radiusScale: large rounded cards and chips, 12/16/22/28px system
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: white elevated cards over pale blue workspace with subtle cool borders and soft shadows
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: rounded admin actions with solid teal primary and bordered secondary controls
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: grid-aligned KPI strips, left-aligned content blocks, compact panel headers, scan-friendly rows

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Use the existing admin shell and separate KPI-driven dashboard, organization governance, project management, and task execution pages.

productContext.productType: construction task and portfolio management platform

pages.title: Portfolio Dashboard
pages.businessScenario: cross-project KPI dashboard for daily portfolio focus and delivery risk triage
pages.visualNorthStar: A clean, executive-ready portfolio dashboard that immediately reveals which project needs focus today and why.
pages.compositionPattern: Structured KPI board with ranked action table
qualityRisks: must stay distinct from organization administration

pages.title: Organization Administration
pages.businessScenario: organization governance, project registry, user management, and project-level administration tools
pages.visualNorthStar: A governance-focused admin page for portfolio structure, users, project tallies, and project administration.

pages.title: Projects
pages.businessScenario: portfolio projects management page for cross-project visibility, health, staffing, schedule status, and project drill-in actions
pages.visualNorthStar: A project management page that makes every active project easy to scan, compare, and open for deeper management.
pages.compositionPattern: Project portfolio board with status cards and active project list
qualityRisks: must remain distinct from dashboard KPI summary
must remain distinct from organization governance

pages.title: Tasks
pages.businessScenario: task execution and triage page for assignment, review, status updates, and operational filtering across project work
pages.visualNorthStar: A focused task workspace that supports quick triage, status scanning, and action without drifting into organization administration or dashboard analytics.
pages.compositionPattern: Operational task board with queue summary and task list
qualityRisks: must remain distinct from dashboard KPI summary
must remain distinct from project management page
